audit.why: Early lane favours Mel (range, W reflects his Q portals); level 6 flips to Malzahar (point-and-click suppress); side lane and late favour Mel once QSS/cleanse is up. Content layer already states this correctly.
Spikes: Mel levels 3-5, Malzahar level 6 (Nether Grasp 140s), Mel first item (Luden's wave clear vs Voidlings), Mel late. spikes[] has all 4 entries and matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer never states which Malzahar spells Rebuttal does NOT stop, cooldowns field has no numbers, and the channel-cancel interaction (Solar Snare cancels Nether Grasp on an ally) is missing.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects Call of the Void (projectile) but Nether Grasp is point-and-click suppression and Malefic Visions is a targeted DoT — neither is blocked. Nether Grasp is a channel, so Mel's root cancels it when cast on an ally (Mel herself is suppressed and cannot cast). Malzahar passive breaks on any damage tick.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart: full layer shows 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] correctly reads Mel x4, Malzahar, Mel, Mel.
audit.why: Two layers must agree; content matches the kit logic and the packet chart, so full sides are aligned to it.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Nether Grasp is point-and-click and ignores your W — his 6 spike outweighs yours until you respect it.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Rebuttal is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1: a whiffed or cleansed suppress buys two minutes of free lane — commit then. - His Q is a flat 6s, E 11s at rank 1; trade right after the portals fire. - Your W is 38s early; chip never gets it — hold it for his full rotation.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Fire Radiant Volley the moment his 6-second Q goes down — that window is silence-free, and every hit banks Overwhelm stacks.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Rebuttal reflects his Q portals, but Nether Grasp and Malefic Visions are not projectiles — the suppress and the DoT go straight through the glow.

edits.before: Track Malzahar’s Nether Grasp: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Nether Grasp ignores Rebuttal but it is a channel — if he suppresses an ally, your Solar Snare root cancels it instantly. Break his passive shield with a Q tick before any real trade.

edits.before: Malzahar wins by landing Nether Grasp, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Malzahar wins by stacking Malefic Visions through your block, silencing your W cast with Q, and suppressing you at 6.
